data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md has a Step 0.6 that reads enforcement.strategy and conditionally loads commit-workflow-validation.md when value is local or both; skips loading when ci
- DD2b: the conditional load adds no more than 1 net Bash call
- DD7: audit criterion B (no unnecessary friction) — ci path leaner than local path

## Description
Insert a new "## Step 0.6: Load Enforcement Profile" section between Step 0.5 and the validation block. The step reads `enforcement.strategy` from `dso-config.conf` (single grep) using exactly one `grep -m1 '^enforcement\.strategy=' "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/dso-config.conf" | cut -d= -f2-`. When value is `ci`, prints "enforcement.strategy=ci — skipping local validation" and skips to Step 4 (Stage). When value is `local`, `both`, or absent, the workflow proceeds to read/execute commit-workflow-validation.md content. Use one Bash block. Add a network-partition warning callout per Considerations [Security].

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (modify)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Step 0.6 section present and references enforcement.strategy
  Verify: grep -A3 "Step 0.6" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | grep -q "enforcement.strategy"
- [ ] Step 0.6 has explicit ci skip-to-Step-4 branch
  Verify: awk '/Step 0.6/,/Step 1/' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | grep -qE "ci.*skip|skip.*Step 4"
- [ ] Single grep call for enforcement.strategy
  Verify: test "$(grep -cE 'grep.*enforcement\\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md)" -le 2
- [ ] Net new Bash blocks ≤ 1 vs. baseline
  Verify: bash -c 'baseline=$(git show HEAD:plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | grep -c "\`\`\`bash"); current=$(grep -c "\`\`\`bash" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md); test $((current - baseline)) -le 1'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
data.title: Add Step 0.6 conditional dispatcher in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
